newsitem.title: USA: U.S. May retail sales fell 0.1 pct, unrevised.
newsitem.headline: U.S. May retail sales fell 0.1 pct, unrevised.

text.p: Commerce Department revised seasonally adjusted data on U.S. retail sales and inventories.
Billions of Dlrs: May Apr Mar
The April inventory-to-sales ratio was unrevised at 1.51 months' worth compared with 1.49 months' worth in March.
The ratio is a measure of how long it would take to sell existing stocks at the current pace.
The department revised its sampling method for measuring retail sales. The changes resulted in only minor revisions to the March through May retail sales and inventories numbers.

The revisions reflect a fuller retail trade sample based on a new sample design that asks about 13,000 retailers to report their sales data every month rather than, in some cases, only every three months.
